description: Pay sats to a BSV P2PKH address (on-chain, settlement=live, txid is a BSV transaction) or to an agentpay wallet id apw_… (internal ledger credit, settlement=internal, txid is a receipt id). Idempotent per idempotency_key. Daily limits, allowlists (spend or agent_send), and approval thresholds apply. Pass the public wallet id, never the secret apw_ token.

approvalId.description: Approval id from a prior approval_required response

dest.description: BSV P2PKH address (1… / 3…) or public agentpay wallet id (apw_…, not the secret token)

idempotency_key.description: Replay key: a retry with the same key returns the original txid/receipt instead of sending twice

key.description: Agent key (agp_…). Optional when the MCP connection sends Authorization: Bearer.

memo.description: Optional note stored on the send

name: send
title: Send to an address or wallet
